question: Who holds this permission set or permission set group?

steps.name: holders
steps.soql: SELECT Assignee.Name, Assignee.Username, Assignee.IsActive, PermissionSet.Name, PermissionSetGroup.DeveloperName, ExpirationDate FROM PermissionSetAssignment WHERE PermissionSet.Name = '{permset}' OR PermissionSetGroup.DeveloperName = '{permset}' ORDER BY Assignee.Name LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: Nobody holds {permset}, or no permission set or group has that name.
{holders.rows} assignment(s), {= holders.records.filter(r => r["Assignee.IsActive"]).length} to active users.

traps: A user given a group appears once per permission set inside the group.
